question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

10, 27, 78, 231, ?, 2067
solution:
**Logic :** Each number is first multiplied by and subtracted from (3) subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b90fe2339fce324b2b1e129d02d010c22f2e8ce545510f464f61291b568fd87.png] 

Hence, **"690"** is the correct answer.
